package.json holds no "exports", no "types", no "typings" and no "main":

  exports["."].types -> undefined
  exports["."].default -> undefined
  types -> undefined
  typings -> undefined
  main -> undefined
  resolved entry point: <none>

Both trees build (tsc exit 0) and both emit dist/main.d.ts, so there is a
declaration on disk. Nothing names it as the package's surface, so there is
nothing to point api-extractor at.
